label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Keep Your Emails Short and Sweet
body: People are busy, so get straight to the point to make your message easy to digest and act on.
caption:
In a world full of notifications and distractions, short emails stand out. When you write less, your readers get more, because they're more likely to actually read what you send. Think about what's essential and trim the rest. Your audience will thank you for respecting their time. Give it a try with your next email! ✨
